sourcePolicy: Nur Rebrickable Catalog Downloads/CSV, keine MOC-Dateien.
methodology: The complete role-specific queue was reviewed against the catalog role and the official top-level LDraw model. Only complete assemblies that use the existing standard minifigure torso-slot origin may become builder-ready. Individual body components and assemblies that require a different figure family or counterpart remain explicitly incompatible instead of receiving a guessed placement.

builderEligible.evidence: Official one-piece Minifig Torso with Integral Arms at the standard torso origin.
Official complete Minifig Torso Brick shortcut containing the body, both arms and both hands.

reviewedIncompatibleQueue.reason: The unique official model is an individual component or requires a non-standard figure-family counterpart/anchor; it is not a complete drop-in assembly for the current minifigure builder slot.
